description: Get your home's GPS coordinates to automate your devices according to the sun's course.
option_1_desc: Use your browser's geolocation to retrieve your current position.
option_2_desc: Enter the country and the name of your city to set your position.
option_2_hint: Pick a suggestion from the list to set your position.
security_text: Privacy & security: This page runs entirely in your browser. No data is stored or sent to any third-party server.
err_gps_unsupported: Geolocation is not supported by your browser.
err_no_results: No results. Try adding the country, or a different spelling.
err_search_failed: Search failed (this step needs an internet connection).
installer_description: Install ESPSomfy-RTS on your device, switch versions and read its logs, without installing anything on your computer.
installer_compat_warning: Browser installation requires a Web Serial capable browser (Chrome, Edge or Opera) on a computer, with this page loaded over HTTPS.
installer_box_eth_boot_notice: For this model: hold down the push button under the box before clicking "Install". Release it once erasing is done and firmware writing has started. Once installation is complete, unplug and replug the box so it exits flashing mode.
installer_flash_state_finished_body: Unplug and replug your device, or just wait: it restarts automatically.
installer_flash_error_not_supported: This firmware doesn't support the detected chip ({chip}).
installer_flash_error_init: Couldn't connect to the device. Try again, or hold the BOOT button while clicking "Install".
installer_footer_text: The firmware is downloaded from the project's GitHub releases; no data is sent to any other third party.
index_description: Use the online tools to set up and run your system with ease.
index_geo_desc: Find your home's GPS coordinates: without them, your system has no idea when the sun rises and sets where you live.
index_installer_desc: Flash an ESP32 over USB from your browser, official box or generic board.
installer_connect_body: Plug your ESP32 into a USB port on this computer, then pick it in the window your browser is about to open. Everything happens here: no data leaves your computer, and the firmware goes straight from this page to the device without passing through a server.
installer_noport_body: Three causes, most common first: a charge-only USB cable with no data wires; a missing USB-to-serial driver (CP2102 or CH340 depending on the board); or the device plugged in after the window opened. Change the cable, install the driver, then try again.
installer_logs_open_error: Could not open the serial port: {message}
installer_connected_body: The port is held. You can install a version of ESPSomfy-RTS, or read what the device writes on its serial link.
installer_manual_body: Pick a complete image downloaded from the releases page. It is named \u201cfactory\u201d from v3 onwards, \u201conboard\u201d on 2.x versions, and ends with your chip name. A .zip archive is read as is, no need to extract it.
installer_manual_notice: Only complete images will do: a file holding just the application or just the filesystem would be written to the wrong place. The target chip is guessed from the file name; if it does not match the connected device, the install is refused before anything is written.
installer_manual_zip_error: Archive unreadable, or compressed in an unsupported format.
